umber.name: Umber
umber.why: Uses the shared base MudWing model at a smaller scale, with his own warm copper-brown palette, amber eyes, nose scar and fitted pouch. No independent Umber body.

moon.name: Moon
moon.why: Four-year-old small but strong-muscled NightWing: broad cranium, tapered beaked muzzle, housed grey horns, fuller shared dragon muscle/foot anatomy, raised resting wing fan, green eyes and silver tears. World scale is inferred, not a canon metric.

blue.name: Blue
blue.why: Rebuilt SilkWing: long rounded muzzle and skull, fitted mouth and staged lateral eyes, paired slender antennae and swept horn housings, lean full-muscle body and articulated digits, four supported articulated wings with rounded membranes and trailing arm attachment.

darkstalker.name: Darkstalker
darkstalker.why: Ancient-adult NightWing scene resident in the northwestern village clearing, not collectible. Corrected shared NightWing anatomy with broad mature musculature, ebony palette, black eyes, long twisted horns, pale wing-root scales and left bone hoop. World scale 10.8 is an inferred giant scale anchored to the large-adult comparison, not a canon metre measurement.

wren.name: Wren
wren.why: Joy Ang's Dragonslayer and Flames of Hope jacket artwork: shoulder-length dark curls, brown eyes, freckles, cream wrap tunic, sage trousers, brown boots and a reddish-brown sword baldric. Teen anatomy rather than a resized six-year-old.

starflight.name: Starflight
starflight.why: Arc 1 Starflight, before the eruption in The Dark Secret: sighted and unscarred. Reuses the shared NightWing model (Moon's mesh and rig) at a larger inferred scale; no separate build yet. Palette and eye colour are not applied to the baked model.

starflight_blind.name: Starflight
starflight_blind.why: Arc 2 Starflight, head librarian of Jade Mountain Academy. Blind since the volcanic eruption in The Dark Secret (clouded eyes here). The wiki also describes long burn scars across his scales and snout, which are NOT modelled yet. Shares Moon's mesh and rig at an inferred larger scale.
